messages:
rachel (product): quick thread to agree on invite queue + minimal screening for the upcoming DP cohort. want a repeatable intake that sales can use.

diego (eng): keep it tiny. we can gate large infra requests later.

sam (sales): sales needs 2 reserved high-touch seats. will add candidates tomorrow.

mira (cs): onboarding will need a 30m kickoff + access to dashboard. include that in the intake.

rachel (product): intake draft (one-liner fields):
- company
- pilot goal (1 sentence)
- expected weekly calls/tokens
- data sensitivity (none/pseudonymized/PII/reg)
- preferred pilot type (hosted/private/high-touch)
- success criteria (how they will measure)

diego (eng): add: "can share sample prompt Y/N" — helps repro.

sam (sales): also: commercial upside? (yes/no) so we can tag enterprise leads.

mira (cs): feedback cadence: weekly async + 2 scheduled check-ins (wk2 + wk4). I'll own the thread template.

rachel (product): prioritization rule (simple): reserve high-touch, then sort by: severity of problem (1-5) * strategic fit (1-5). any tie -> sales priority.

diego (eng): metrics tagging note: label traffic by partner_id + traffic_mode (test/primary/fallback).

audit-bot: created doc pilot-intake-template -> drafts/pilot-intake-v1.md

rachel (product): action items: sam -> list candidates (24h), diego -> add tagging (EOW), mira -> share thread template (48h). will finalize outreach copy after that. thanks :thumbsup:
